categories.main_business_segments: Merit Interactive Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the data intelligence sector, focusing on three core business layers: developer services (providing SDKs for mobile app push notifications, user authentication, and cross-platform data integration), data governance (offering a data intelligent operating system for data processing and management), and data applications (commercial services including data empowerment, risk control, brand services, and public services such as SaaS products for government and public governance). The company also explores vertical industry applications in smart transportation and healthcare.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages big data technologies, artificial intelligence, and advanced data governance methods. It has developed a proprietary data intelligent operating system (DiOS) that integrates data scheduling, modeling, development, visualization, and machine learning. The firm actively incorporates AI large models, vectorization, knowledge graphs, and privacy computing technologies, including partnerships with major AI models like ChatGPT and domestic large models. It also employs secure data fusion, blockchain, and trusted data spaces to enable compliant and efficient data flow.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Merit Interactive serves a broad range of customers including mobile app developers, internet platforms, government agencies, and financial institutions. Its commercial services cater to internet and financial sectors, while public services target government departments across over 2,900 county-level units in China. The company also extends services to industries such as smart transportation, healthcare, consumer brands, and automotive marketing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with nearly all revenue generated domestically. It has established partnerships and projects in regions like Zhejiang Province and Hainan, including international data cooperation initiatives. Overseas revenue is minimal, accounting for approximately 0.02% of total revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: Merit Interactive operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the data intelligence supply chain. It accumulates and governs data (midstream) and provides data-driven applications and services to end customers (downstream), including SaaS products and data empowerment solutions. It also facilitates data flow and value creation through its 'data dispatch station' platform, connecting data providers, users, and service providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on the 'self-data, govern-data, place-data' framework, emphasizing data accumulation, governance, and market-oriented data exchange. It prioritizes R&D in AI large models, trusted data spaces, and secure data computing platforms. The firm invests heavily in AI integration, vertical industry model development, and expanding data application scenarios in smart transportation, healthcare, and public governance. It also fosters ecosystem collaboration and innovation through its research institute and industry partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through service fees from developer SDKs, data governance platforms, commercial data services (including data empowerment, risk control, and brand marketing), and public sector SaaS products. The company also earns from data licensing, subscription-based SaaS offerings, and project-based contracts. Advertising-related services operate on performance-based models such as CPA, CPC, and CPS.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Merit Interactive is a leading early entrant and industry frontrunner in China's data intelligence market. It holds a dominant position in third-party push notification services and data intelligence applications. The company is recognized by national authorities and actively participates in setting industry standards. While specific competitors are not named, the firm’s extensive data assets, technological capabilities, and ecosystem investments position it as a market leader.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 470 million, a 9.41% increase from 2023. Despite a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 64.75 million, adjusted net profit excluding non-recurring items was positive. The company maintains substantial assets totaling around RMB 1.85 billion and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures exceeding RMB 169 million. It has a stable customer base and shows signs of business recovery and growth trajectory realignment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Merit Interactive emphasizes making data easy to use and legally compliant, delivering high-quality, actionable data intelligence solutions. Its unique value lies in its comprehensive data accumulation, sophisticated governance via its DiOS platform, and scalable data applications tailored to vertical industries. The company’s integration of AI large models and trusted data spaces ensures secure, efficient data flow and innovative service offerings. Its strong ecosystem partnerships and early adoption of cutting-edge technologies differentiate it in the competitive landscape.
